units.source_text: 浮舟送诸人出门后，寂寞地回到房内，

en.t: After Ukifune saw everyone out, she returned lonely to her room,

units.source_text: 想道：“我身世飘零，除了依靠此人之外，毫无办法。

en.t: thinking, "My life has drifted so helplessly that I have no choice but to rely on this person.

units.source_text: 现在此人也不在家，叫我好孤单啊！”

en.t: And now even this person is away from home, leaving me so terribly alone!"

units.source_text: 正在寂寞无聊之时，中将派人送信来了。

en.t: Just as she was feeling lonely and listless, the Captain sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 少将说：“请小姐拆看。”

en.t: Shojo said, "Please open it and read it, my lady."

units.source_text: 但浮舟睬也不睬。

en.t: But Ukifune paid it no attention at all.

units.source_text: 此后她更少与人见面，只是茫然地思前想后。

en.t: After that she saw people even less, only staring blankly as her thoughts wandered back and forth.

units.source_text: 少将对她说道：“小姐如此愁闷，连我也觉痛苦。

en.t: Shojo said to her, "When you are so weighed down with sorrow, my lady, even I feel pain.

units.source_text: 我们来下棋吧。”

en.t: Let us play a game of go."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“下棋我也很笨拙。”

en.t: Ukifune answered, "I am very poor at go as well."

units.source_text: 嘴上虽这么说，然而好像有意一试。

en.t: Though she said so, she seemed somewhat willing to give it a try.

units.source_text: 少将便把棋盘取来。

en.t: So Shojo brought out the go board.

units.source_text: 她自以为能干，让浮舟先下。

en.t: Thinking herself skilled, she let Ukifune play first.

units.source_text: 岂知浮舟手段非常高明。

en.t: To her surprise, Ukifune's play was remarkably skillful.

units.source_text: 于是第二次她自己先下了。

en.t: So in the second game she herself took the first move.

units.source_text: 她说：“我希望师父早日回来看看小姐的棋。

en.t: She said, "I wish my teacher would come back soon and see your go, my lady.

units.source_text: 师父下棋真能干呢！

en.t: My teacher is truly good at go!

units.source_text: 僧都年轻时非常喜欢下棋，自以为手段高明，不亚于棋圣大德。

en.t: When the Sozu was young, he loved go and believed his skill was no worse than that of the go sage Daitoku.

units.source_text: 有一次对他妹妹说道：‘我虽不以棋道著名于世，但你的棋总赢不过我。’

en.t: Once he said to his younger sister, 'Though I am not famous in the world for go, you will never beat me at it.'

units.source_text: 两人便下起来，结果僧都输了二子。

en.t: The two of them then began to play, and in the end the Sozu lost by two stones.

units.source_text: 如此看来，师父的棋比棋圣大德还高明呢！

en.t: Seen in that light, my teacher's go is even better than the go sage Daitoku's!

units.source_text: 唉，真了不起啊！”

en.t: Ah, it really is extraordinary!"

units.source_text: 她说得兴致勃勃。

en.t: She spoke with great enthusiasm.

units.source_text: 此人年纪已大，尼僧的额发又很难看，玩这种技艺实不相称。

en.t: The woman was already old, and with a nun's unattractive forehead hair, it hardly suited her to indulge in such a pastime.

units.source_text: 浮舟觉得今天开了这个例是自找麻烦，

en.t: Ukifune felt that by allowing this precedent today she had only brought trouble on herself,

units.source_text: 下了一会之后，就推说精神不好，躺下来休息了。

en.t: and after playing for a while, she excused herself by saying she felt unwell and lay down to rest.

units.source_text: 少将说：“小姐应当常常找些乐趣，开开胸怀。

en.t: Shojo said, "My lady, you should often find some amusement and lighten your heart.

units.source_text: 这样花容月貌的人，只管消沉度日，岂不可惜！

en.t: For someone as beautiful as flowers and the moon to spend her days only in gloom is such a pity!

units.source_text: 这正好比是美玉之瑕呢。”

en.t: It is just like a flaw in a beautiful jewel."

units.source_text: 秋夜风声凄厉，浮舟百感交集，独吟云：

en.t: On the autumn night, the wind sounded bleak and fierce; filled with countless feelings, Ukifune chanted alone:
